json.title: Gangtok Sunrise Pink
json.logline: A family winter drive up to Gangtok culminates in the breathtaking sight of snow peaks glowing pink at dawn.

palette: soft sage green in distant foliage
character_rules: one protagonist appears in every scene with the same face, hair length and build
wardrobe is identical from the first scene to the last
the face stays readable in at least three-quarter profile
style_bible.lighting: cinematic low-angle golden-hour light with gentle halation and soft falloff
style_bible.medium: loose gouache painting with visible brush strokes and softly blended colour

events.visual: Soft felt piano opens over painted morning dusk.
Valleys open up with golden gouache brushstrokes.
Kick drum enters as sunlight begins to hit the snow peaks.
Himalayan peaks ignite in glowing rose pink sunrise light.
Warm painted collage layers shimmer in golden sun.
Drums fade into a gentle decaying piano chord.
Soft golden shimmer fades gently into canvas texture.

scenes.camera_note: Slow push in on character looking out foggy car window
scenes.action: The young man wearing a heavy navy wool coat gazes through a frost-edged car window.
scenes.setting: Inside a vintage car parked along a foggy mountain pass in Sikkim at dawn.

scenes.camera_note: Parallax motion across high mountain valley road
scenes.action: An old yellow hatchback rests on a winding mountain road overlooking blue misty valleys.
scenes.setting: High-altitude mountain road near Gangtok surrounded by dense pine forests.

scenes.camera_note: Tilt up from car hood to the morning sky
scenes.action: A steaming metal mug sits on the hood of the car reflecting morning light.
scenes.setting: Car hood overlook point with distant Himalayan mountain ridges in the soft background.

scenes.camera_note: Quick push in on character face turn
scenes.action: The young man turns his face toward the brightening eastern sky.
scenes.setting: Observation deck in Gangtok under cold morning air.

scenes.camera_note: Wide reveal pull out as Kanchenjunga glows pink
scenes.action: Massive snowy Himalayan peaks glow in vivid rose pink light as morning sun hits the summits.
scenes.setting: Panoramic Gangtok viewpoint facing the illuminated snow peaks of Kanchenjunga.

scenes.camera_note: Multi-layered memory motion with bright fluttering flags
scenes.action: The young man stands by the car railing looking up at the glowing pink mountains.
scenes.setting: Sunlit Gangtok valley viewpoint with fluttering colourful prayer flags.

scenes.camera_note: Slow dolly out as memory calms and settles
scenes.action: The young man smiles softly with warm sunrise light reflecting on his black glasses.
scenes.setting: Quiet balcony overlooking the quiet mountain town bathed in amber light.
